name: Forge3D
summary: Desktop OpenSCAD IDE with a native Apple Silicon Mac preview and provider-neutral Design, Assembly, and print-preparation MCP tools.
requirements: The macOS v3.2.0 DMG is an ad-hoc-signed Apple Silicon development preview without Developer ID or notarization; individual macOS approval may be required
Node.js 22+ and npm 10+ for source builds
OpenSCAD language-server support is limited to Windows development builds
highlights: OpenSCAD editor with native OpenSCAD render loop
Three.js viewport with orbit, pan, zoom, grid, axes, and dimension overlays
Parameter controls from OpenSCAD variables and // @param annotations
File open/save, STL export, recent files, and workspace browser
Surface measurement and non-destructive through-hole assembly tools
15 local MCP tools: native Design modeling, multi-part Assembly, print-bed layout, STL export, and real viewport capture

screenshots.alt: Forge3D editor and 3D viewport with dimension brackets
